name: Ophelia
message: I'm not certain what you mean. Judging by where we are, I'd assume it's got something to do with Mother?

name: Polonius
message: Today marks the day your mother and I were first wed.

name: Polonius
message: She was close to your age then. We were so very—so wonderfully young. I wish I could remember my own mind at that point in my life.

name: Polonius
message: Everything was so clean and simple, and matters so easy to sort through.

name: Polonius
message: Do you ever miss your mother?

name: Polonius
message: You were so small when Elise died. Hardly able to move on your own. And sickly, too. She was terrified she'd lose you as she lay ill.

name: Polonius
message: She handed you to a nursemaid instead of continuing to feed you. It likely saved your life, though it brought her immense pain to do.

name: Polonius
message: Your mother was the light of my life.

name: Polonius
message: When she left us, my life—well—I have you, and Laertes. Were it not for you two, my world would have gone completely dark.

name: Polonius
message: For many years it was as though nothing would ever make me smile again. My hair grew white, and my hands feeble. I felt I needed her to live.

name: Polonius
message: You are the spitting image of her. Sometimes, when you were small, I could hardly bear to look at your face. It was too painful.

name: Polonius
message: But I know she'd be so terribly, terribly proud of you and Laertes.

name: Polonius
message: That's what has kept me alive these many years.
